messages:
morgan: quick heads-up — seeing funcall output typed as `string` in TS SDK when server returns `{ result: null }` for optional fields. repro below.

morgan: repro (ts)
```ts
const res = await client.funcall('summarize', { text: null });
// expected: { summary: null }
// got: "null"
```

morgan: also observed while streaming: when token refresh race happens mid-stream, SDK closes stream and emits error but callback fired with partial buffered text. Might be related to auth retry wrapper.

jai: @morgan thanks, can you paste the raw wire payload? is server sending content-encoding? :eyes: 

morgan: payload (raw)
```json
{"type":"function.result","output":{"summary":null}}
```

sara: looks like our TS client coercion path treats any non-object as scalar and stringifies. I think coercion helper needs to be more defensive: if schema expects object/nullable, preserve null.

sara: proposal: add `coerceFuncOutput(raw, schema)` helper that uses ajv/quicktype to map types, with explicit null branches.

sara: snippet
```ts
function coerceFuncOutput(raw: any, schema: Schema) {
  if (raw === null) return null;
  if (schema.type === 'object' && typeof raw === 'string') {
    try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return raw; }
  }
  return raw;
}
```

kevin: for streaming/race: our auth refresh currently does a full reconnect. Can we instead surface `retryWithResume` option that resumes downstream with same stream_id? Might need server support but worth API.

ben: I've got a small patch for Ruby gem that mirrors TS coercion. will open PR and add unit tests.

ben: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/882

ciara-bot: CI started for ruby-sdk/pr/882 — tests: unit, integration (funcalls)

morgan: thanks. also, small UX ask: when funcall schema mismatch occurs we should include the expected schema path in the error message (e.g., `expected object at output.summary but got string`).

sara: agreed. I'll add enhanced error messages and a flag `STRICT_FUNC_OUTPUT` to enable stricter validation during canary.

kevin: fyi I'll prototype `retryWithResume` in runtime branch. If server can't resume we'll fallback to full reconnect and emit `:resume_failed` metric.

jai: pinging @devex for code review on TS helper — link?

sara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ts-sdk/pull/1451 — includes tests & docs. :thumbsup:

alice: quick note — make sure to add an integration test that simulates token-refresh mid-stream (we have harness in eng-runtime/tests/stream_retry_simulator)

ben: ci green so far :white_check_mark:

morgan: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll follow up after TS PR merges and we have a canary rollout plan.

sara: leaving a checklist:
- update coercion helper
- add better error messages
- add TS + Ruby unit tests
- add integration: token-refresh mid-stream
- create canary config

kevin: taking canary rollout on runtime side. estimate 2 days.

morgan: cool. resolved for now unless someone hits more repros. :wave:
